fr_html: Le PRESIDENT observe que le texte de M. Hagerup distingue entre traitement et indemnité et donne aux juges titulaires un traitement fixe, tandis que les suppléants ne recevront qu'une indemnité. C'est la différence fondamentale entre l'idée de M. Hagerup et celle de M. de Lapradelle.
en_html: The PRESIDENT pointed out that M. Hagerup's wording distinguished between salary and indemnities. It gave the regular judges a fixed salary, whereas the deputy judges would only receive an indemnity. That was the essential difference between M. Hagerup's idea and that of M. de Lapradelle.
